confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are medium-quality: they come from commercial travel guides with mixed dates and some euro/dollar ambiguity, and the cappuccino figure is weakly supported. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the beer anchor because no direct cocktail or wine price was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. FX is weak: the only RBA reference returned by search is dated 2026-03-20 (0.7088 USD per AUD), which is about seven months before the 2026-10-16 generation date, and the rba.gov.au page itself was not opened, so the value is unverified and not the latest observation. The latest-observation search did not return a verified current RBA rate, and the non-RBA OFX rate (about 0.702 USD per AUD, August 2026) was not used. Euro conversions assume roughly 1.15 USD per EUR, which was not sourced.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to tourist-heavy Italian coastal towns in the Naples and Amalfi Coast area, with July peak-season accommodation pricing assumed. Drink anchors use the local beer relationship: cocktail is about 1.7 times the beer price and house wine by the glass is about equal to beer. Euro figures were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR.
